Container.Name: vigilant-vole
Container.Overview: Lightweight self-hosted uptime monitor written in Rust: HTTP(S), keyword, JSON query, TCP, ping, DNS, push, Docker, WebSocket, domain expiry, NTP and Steam monitors; 24 notification providers plus Apprise; status pages with custom domains, incidents and badges; maintenance windows; remote agents; REST API, config as code and Prometheus metrics. One static binary, one SQLite file. Open the WebUI after the first start to create the admin account.
Container.Requires: For Docker container monitors and label discovery: map the Docker socket below and add --group-add with the socket's GID (stat -c %g /var/run/docker.sock) to Extra Parameters.

Config.Name: WebUI port
Config.Description: Web interface, API, status pages and /metrics.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: SQLite database, session key and backups. Must be writable by the container user (99:100 by default).

Config.Name: Docker socket (optional)
Config.Description: Only needed for Docker container monitors and label auto-discovery. Leave empty to disable.

Config.Name: VV_TRUST_PROXY
Config.Description: Set to 1 when the WebUI is only reachable through a reverse proxy (SWAG, Nginx Proxy Manager, Traefik) that sets X-Forwarded-* headers.

Config.Name: VV_CONFIG_FILE
Config.Description: Optional path (inside the container, e.g. /data/vigilant.yml) to a YAML/JSON config file merged into the database on every start.
